$comment: GENERATED by extraction/build_token_catalog.py from tokens/{00-foundation,10-semantic,20-component,30-layout,themes}. Do not hand-edit: extraction/verify_all.py rebuilds it and fails on any difference, so neither this file nor a token file can change alone. Every value is copied from a token file (which cites tailwind.config.js / src / CLONE_SPEC.md); nothing here is invented. A PageSpec names tokens by these paths (tokens/llm/token-policy.json pageSpecTokenSlots), never by raw values.

absent.elevation: There are NO elevation tokens. Every box-shadow, gradient and backdrop-filter computes to none on the original; depth comes only from the stepped surface colours. The button label's text-shadow (0 1.5em surface-1) is a masking technique for the roll-up, not elevation.

color.link-hover.usage: footer link hover, mobile AI link border

color.surface-1.usage: cards, pagination pill, primary button text

color.surface-2.usage: nav pill, dropdown panel, case-study stat blocks

color.surface-3.usage: dark button, active assistant tab, tab dividers, quote base colour

fontFamily.serif.note: H1 and every H2 are Instrument Serif 400 (declared 500 on the original, but only 400 exists).

layout.pageWrapper.value: The wrapper itself carries 4rem (64px at the 16px root) top padding, so the hero section starts at y=64 (pixel-audit correction; CLONE_SPEC only mentions the hero's own padding). The wrapper moved from App.jsx into components/Layout.jsx when the router was added.

motion.easing.inOutQuart.value: cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1) (CSS fallback; linear() quartic where supported)

motion.easing.outQuart.value: cubic-bezier(0.165, 0.84, 0.44, 1) (CSS fallback; linear() quartic where supported) -- Webflow IX2 outQuart

motion.easing.tailwind-default.value: Tailwind's default transition timing cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), applied where the clone sets a duration class but no ease class

motion.reducedMotionFallback.autoplay-of.value: Do not autoplay; render paused with the play control available; slide changes are instant.

motion.reducedMotionFallback.instant-fin.value: Render the end state immediately (fully visible, unscaled, final colour). No scroll scrub, no load reveal.

motion.reducedMotionFallback.instant-sli.value: Change slides without the 800ms transform transition; manual controls keep working.

motion.reducedMotionFallback.instant-tog.value: Switch open/closed or active state immediately, without the transition.

motion.reducedMotionFallback.static-firs.value: Do not animate the loop: render the first frame (first row / un-translated track) statically.

radius.avatarBelow1440.note: Testimonial avatar corners below 1440 (top-left + bottom-right only). Source writes rounded-[0.375rem_0] (= 6px 0 at the 16px root), wide:rounded-avatar from 1440.

semantic.surface.card.usage: results cards, FAQ cards, feature slides, footer card, pagination pill

semantic.surface.hover.usage: nav items, dropdown items, social icons

semantic.surface.page.usage: body, page wrapper, footer, nav at <=479

semantic.surface.raised.usage: nav pill, dropdown panel, case-study stat blocks, placeholders

semantic.text.quoteBase.usage: scroll-highlight quote before it is scrubbed to white

space.16.usage: spacer-small, card grid gap, container-large padding-top

space.24.usage: slide gap, button-group gap, header column gap <=991

space.4.usage: H2 margin-top (every H2), dropdown column gap

space.64.usage: page-wrapper top padding, hero top padding, assistant header margin-top

space.8.usage: CTA wrap gap, pagination bullet gap, footer link gap

space.paragraphMarginBottom.note: Most paragraphs carry margin-bottom 20px (pixel-audit correction: 9x p.text-color-grey, 11x subdued-text, ... all mb=20px on the original).
